    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#脚本引擎之AScript与DynamicExpresso对比</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 id="h_2073349099592610288_0" data-first-child="" data-into-catalog-status="">一 简介</h2>
<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_1" data-into-catalog-status="">1、AScript</h3>
<p data-pid="l70OT3Xn">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持自定义语法，支持扩展多种脚本语言（目前已支持C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua五种语言），支持解释执行和编译执行两种执行模式，并且支持编译缓存，以适配不同场景下对性能的要求。</p>
<p data-pid="lAOtJj0J">目前官方最新版本：1.6.0</p>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_2" data-into-catalog-status="">2、DynamicExpresso</h3>
<p data-pid="YxDH5voa">DynamicExpresso是一个开源的，用.<a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=281675604&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=NET+Standard+2.0&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">NET Standard 2.0</a>编写的简单c#语句的解释器，将表达式转换为.NET lambda表达式或委托来执行c#语句。</p>
<p data-pid="2UWc1AAe">目前官方最新版本：2.19.3</p>
<p data-pid="3NSPMWUv">开源地址：<a title="https://github.com/dynamicexpresso/DynamicExpresso" href="https://github.com/dynamicexpresso/DynamicExpresso" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dynamicexpresso/DynamicExpresso</a></p>
<h2 id="h_2073349099592610288_3" data-into-catalog-status="">二 性能测试</h2>
<p data-pid="2-pCL9CA">使用Benchmark工具进行性能基准测试，测试环境：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>BenchmarkDotNet v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14.0</span>, Windows <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22621.4317</span>/22H2/2022Update/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">SunValley2)

<div class="cnblogs_code">

<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_4" data-into-catalog-status="">1、常量表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待测试表达式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">100 * (5 + 5) * (6-2)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="PFdV56KG">分3个测试场景：</p>
<p data-pid="t0RtEeq3">1）解释执行</p>
<p data-pid="h0aMYVde">DynamicExpresso不支持解释执行，对AScript的解释执行模式进行测试，以进行综合评价，测试代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript1()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</div>

<p data-pid="7V8JHANc">3）编译缓存</p>
<p data-pid="lYL5CWv3">此为通用缓存场景，根据字符串表达式缓存编译生成的委托，提高整体性能。AScript已内置缓存功能，DynamicExpresso需手动添加缓存逻辑。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script _Script3;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript3_Cache()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Script3 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         _Script3 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = _Script3.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(s, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Delegate&gt; _DynamicExpresso3Dict = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Delegate&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expresso3()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> key =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!_DynamicExpresso3Dict.TryGetValue(key, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func))

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         func = interpreter.ParseAsDelegate&lt;Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         _DynamicExpresso3Dict[key] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = ((Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)func)();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260822083314215-1949210662.jpg" alt="0981aff3eb6df6d3bf9a731606f549d6_v2-222c1cfb9842cbb356d09c4ac60c87f1_r" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="c-KgLhH5">小结：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="AAogrZOr">解释执行模式对比编译执行模式有一定优势，因为编译生成委托成本比较大。</li>
<li data-pid="-8YK2BJM">编译执行模式，AScript比DynamicExpresso性能高。</li>
<li data-pid="huwpL_bQ">编译缓存模式，DynamicExpresso性能略高于AScript。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_5" data-into-catalog-status="">2、变量表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待测试表达式，包含a、b、c三个变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a * (b + 5) * (c-2)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="uRPG9bgU">分3个测试场景：</p>
<p data-pid="e44tRs5J">1）解释执行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript1()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);

<p data-pid="LXrRrUlS">3）编译缓存</p>
<p data-pid="kQa8m89h">DynamicExpresso编译生成委托后，如果再修改上下文中的变量值，委托执行结果不会变，不会动态从上下文获取变量，所以对DynamicExpresso的编译缓存测试没有意义。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript3_Cache()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(s, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_7" data-into-catalog-status="">4、生成委托</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript1()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> func = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a + b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<h3 id="h_2073349099592610288_8" data-into-catalog-status="">5、生成Lambda</h3>

<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260822083949730-1877063467.jpg" alt="6c34b4003628c6c32cc02a10a24073b4_v2-16e717267dd7fa4f49af18dfb1c8f8b4_1440w" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="O0lUv8E9">小结：AScript性能高。</p>
<h2 id="h_2073349099592610288_9" data-into-catalog-status="">三 总结</h2>
<p data-pid="zK7VvKle">1）AScript支持多语句，DynamicExpresso不支持，通过多次调用Eval方式来实现多语句；</p>
<p data-pid="ygI1GpQ8">2）AScript比DynamicExpresso性能高，内存占用低；</p>
<p data-pid="du8RZthK">3）AScript默认为解释执行模式，不缓存也能有较高的性能；</p>
<p data-pid="FAQQQLhH">4）AScript内置编译缓存功能，支持缓存版本号和定时缓存，不同应用场景使用合适的缓存策略，来提高项目整体性能。</p>

</div>
